$comment: CWN 6.2.8 spirit powers, transcribed from the CWN SRD. Cost is the number of points added to the spirit's Effort cost.

powers.name: Airy Steps
powers.effect: The spirit can fly at its normal Move rate. Physical spirits can carry a load.

powers.name: Artifice-Wise
powers.effect: The spirit can use common modern technology, but not weapons or armor.

powers.name: Aura of Destruction
powers.effect: Gain a damage bonus of half its hit dice and damage melee attackers

powers.name: Curse
powers.effect: Target a foe with -1 skill checks and -2 hit/damage. Increases with levels.

powers.name: Ensnare
powers.effect: Make a target unable to move from their location until freed

powers.name: Favor
powers.effect: Target an ally with a bonus to checks or combat rolls for a particular end

powers.name: Feral Pact
powers.effect: Speak with and command animals of the same type as the animal-spirit

powers.name: Finned Swiftness
powers.effect: Swim at twice the spirit’s usual Move rate

powers.name: Flesh of Clay
powers.effect: The spirit cannot be affected by Traumatic Hits.

powers.name: Ghostly Presence
powers.effect: The spirit is invisible until it takes a violent action or draws attention.

powers.name: Hideous Talons
powers.effect: Gain a bonus to the combat statistics granted by Violent Will.

powers.name: Iron Eidolon
powers.effect: A physical form is immune to non-magic weapons, but not unarmed hits.

powers.name: Merciful Hands
powers.effect: Accept damage to the spirit in order to heal damage to a wounded ally.

powers.name: Mighty Form
powers.effect: Gain tremendous physical strength, though it’s too slow to use in combat.

powers.name: Mislead
powers.effect: Cause a moving target to move in whatever direction the spirit wishes.

powers.name: Misty Form
powers.effect: The spirit can flow through any barrier that isn’t watertight.

powers.name: Mortal Disguise
powers.effect: The spirit can look like a normal human being, except under close study.

powers.name: Myrmidon’s Shield
powers.effect: When your summoner takes a Traumatic Hit, take it in their place.

powers.name: Natural Immunity
powers.effect: Become immune to a substance or source of harm in line with its nature.

powers.name: Poltergeist
powers.effect: Telekinetically manipulate objects at a distance with a weak strength.

powers.name: Skilled
powers.effect: Pick a skill or role and add +2 to the spirit’s skill checks related to it.

powers.name: Spiderlegs
powers.effect: Walk on vertical or overhanging surfaces as if they were flat ground.

powers.name: Spirit of War
powers.effect: Enhance Violent Will’s combat abilities, but become merciless in combat.

powers.name: Spirit Whispers
powers.effect: Make a suggestion to a listener that they do not find deeply objectionable.

powers.name: Spirit’s Eye
powers.effect: Enhance the spirit’s senses and grant it a +2 bonus to Notice checks.

powers.name: Swift Pursuit
powers.effect: The spirit’s Move increases by 10 meters and it gets +2 to chase things.

powers.name: Violent Will
powers.effect: The spirit is capable of fighting, but will not use mortal arms or armor.
